upstream.name: mozilla/readability
upstream.architecture: JavaScript DOM scoring/extraction engine, readerable preflight, JSDOM parser shim, metadata extraction, content cleanup, and fixture-driven expected HTML/metadata parity.

benchmarkDenominator.source: Shallow sparse upstream checkout in .upstream-cache/readability at commit 08be6b4bdb204dd333c9b7a0cfbc0e730b257252; counted package.json test runner, test/test-*.js harnesses, and test/test-pages fixture directories. The Mozilla normalize-spaces and parsely-metadata source.html, expected.html, and expected-metadata.json fixtures are now copied into the lane and mapped by native PHP tests.

runnerStatus.reason: The full upstream runner could not execute in the sparse cache because dependencies were not installed. Probe command `npm test` reached the package script `mocha test/test-*.js` and failed before running tests with `sh: line 1: mocha: command not found`. Installing upstream npm dependencies was deferred to keep this lane slice modest.

mappedSemantics: Readability-readerable default minContentLength 140 and minScore 20 scoring thresholds.
Readability-readerable custom minContentLength and minScore options.
Readerable rejection for hidden, aria-hidden, li p, and unlikely class/id candidates.
Readability unlikely candidate and role cleanup for migration/page-builder chrome.
Semantic article/main/section scoring preference over outer page containers.
WordPress block serialization for extracted headings and paragraphs.

Mozilla test-pages/normalize-spaces source/expected/metadata fixture: document-title precedence, readerable true classification, null byline/site/published/dir metadata, excerpt whitespace normalization, and extracted article text parity against expected.html.

Mozilla test-pages/parsely-metadata source/expected/metadata fixture: Parse.ly title, byline, and published-time metadata extraction, readerable true classification, excerpt normalization, null site/dir/lang metadata, and extracted article text parity against expected.html.
benchmarkDenominator.warning: This replaces the seed denominator with a cloned static inventory and now maps two Mozilla page fixtures locally, but it is still not upstream runner parity. Native PHP progress maps 9 local behavior tests and 25 local checks against a 1984-test upstream Mocha denominator.

nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Native DOM extractor removes chrome and unlikely candidates, scores semantic content containers, implements Mozilla-style isProbablyReaderable thresholds, extracts document/Parse.ly titles before in-article headings, exposes byline/site/published/dir/lang metadata fields including Parse.ly author/date selectors, maps the Mozilla normalize-spaces and parsely-metadata fixtures, and emits simple WordPress blocks.

wordpressScenario: Migration-aware article cleanup into clean WordPress blocks with page-builder navigation, comment widgets, share UI, surrounding theme chrome, and copied Mozilla fixture parity for whitespace-normalized article extraction plus Parse.ly metadata extraction.
nextTask: Map another Mozilla fixture with siteName, lang/dir, or media handling, then improve metadata/media cleanup and broader expected-HTML parity.
